title: Open Research Europe becomes fee-free in 11 countries
dek: Researchers in 11 countries can now publish on the Commission's open-access platform without publication fees, under a collective funding model.
key_facts: Open Research Europe (European Commission open-access publishing)
No publication fees for researchers in 11 countries
Eligible countries and conditions in the official announcement
body: Researchers in 11 countries can now publish in Open Research Europe, the European Commission's open-access publishing platform, without paying publication fees, under a collective funding model.
The official announcement lists the eligible countries and the conditions.
why: Open-access publication is mandatory for Horizon Europe results. A fee-free route reduces the dissemination costs that consortia must budget for, so it is worth checking eligibility before fixing the dissemination budget in a proposal.
